source.detail: The investment entity founded by Fawaz Abdulaziz Alhokair, focused on healthcare and financial services and distinct from Fawaz Alhokair Group, the retail and mall operating business. ⚠ It carries a DATED TRIGGER, which is rare for us: in March 2024 it announced a direct-lending joint venture with Z Capital Group targeting Saudi SME lending — a new lending book is exactly when portfolio and risk infrastructure gets bought. ⚠ City unconfirmed.
